comment: * Helper class for managing a connection to the ImsFeature manager.

variables.name: UNAVAILABLE_REASON_DISCONNECTED
variables.comment:
* This Connection has become unavailable due to the ImsService being disconnected due to
     * an event such as SIM Swap, carrier configuration change, etc...
     *
     * {@link Listener#connectionReady}  will be called when a new Manager is available.

variables.name: UNAVAILABLE_REASON_NOT_READY
variables.comment:
* This Connection has become unavailable due to the ImsService moving to the NOT_READY state.
     *
     * {@link Listener#connectionReady}  will be called when the manager moves back to ready.

variables.name: UNAVAILABLE_REASON_IMS_UNSUPPORTED
variables.comment:
* IMS is not supported on this device. This should be considered a permanent error and
     * a Manager will never become available.

variables.name: UNAVAILABLE_REASON_SERVER_UNAVAILABLE
variables.comment:
* The server of this information has crashed or otherwise generated an error that will require * a retry to connect. This is rare, however in this case, {@link #disconnect()} and * {@link #connect()} will need to be called again to recreate the connection with the server. *

* Only applicable if this is used outside of the server's own process.

variables.name: mReadyFilter
variables.comment: for changes into one of the states in this list.

variables.name: mLastReadyState
variables.comment: Also, do not send the first unavailable until after we have moved to available once.

methods.name: public void connect()
methods.comment:
* Start the creation of a connection to the underlying ImsService implementation. When the
     * service is connected, {@link FeatureConnector.Listener#connectionReady} will be
     * called with an active instance.
     *
     * If this device does not support an ImsStack (i.e. doesn't support
     * {@link PackageManager#FEATURE_TELEPHONY_IMS} feature), this method will do nothing.

methods.name: private boolean isSupported()
methods.comment: Check if this ImsFeature is supported or not.

methods.name: public void disconnect()
methods.comment:
* Disconnect from the ImsService Implementation and clean up. When this is complete,
     * {@link FeatureConnector.Listener#connectionUnavailable(int)} will be called one last time.

methods.name: private void notifyReady(U manager, int subId) throws ImsException

methodNames: private void notifyReady(U manager, int subId) throws ImsException
